content.title: Cleveland-Cliffs’ Investors Bail After $1 Billion Share Offer
content.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs intends to issue 75 million shares to pay down debt, triggering a selloff by shareholders on fears the additional stock will dilute the value of the steelmaker’s existing shares.  The company countered by revealing a memorandum of understanding with South Korean steel giant POSCO that Cliffs said will be “highly accretive to shareholders.”  Cliffs said the memo was signed in September, but provided no details about the arrangement.
